{{Quote|I can't believe it was one of us, someone just like us."<br />"He's nothing like us!"<br />"Lets hope he is, if he is like us, he'll realize he's wrong.|Hotshot to [[Whiplash (Clone Youth Brigade)/Legends|Whiplash]] and [[Jax]]|<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>}}
'''Hotshot''' was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]] member of the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
As the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadets]] took their tour of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Jedi Cruiser]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']], he and a fellow cadet named [[Whiplash (Clone Youth Brigade)/Legends|Whiplash]] harassed [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had infiltrated their regiment, using the name "Lucky". He was never very trusting of Boba Fett, which he made very apparent. After Boba Fett sabotaged the Jedi cruiser [[Endurance/Legends|Endurance]] he, along with the rest of the Clone Cadets, were sent to the escape pods. Hotshot was in the same [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] as Boba, along with [[Jax (clone cadet)/Legends|Jax]] and Whiplash when [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] arrived in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] to rescue Boba. Aurra Sing then coldly ordered Boba to jettison Hotshot, Whip, and Jax into deep space.<ref name="Death Trap" />

==Personality and traits==
Hotshot was known to be a trouble maker, at least from the perspective of [[Jax (clone cadet)/Legends|Jax]], as evidenced by the latter ordering him to stand down. He constantly harassed Boba Fett, using the name "Lucky", and was always wary of him.<ref name="Death Trap" />
